metadata.description: Citizenship requirements and pathways for Bangladeshi nationals
metadata.note: Bangladesh allows dual citizenship for most nationalities. Verify current Bangladesh Nationality Law before renouncing.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 3 out of last 5 years as PR (1080 days)
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: CLB 4 in English or French (IELTS approximately 4.0-4.5)
citizenshipRules.civicsTestDescription: Canadian citizenship test - 20 multiple choice questions from Discover Canada guide
citizenshipRules.ageRequirement: 18+ for own application, minors included in parent application
citizenshipRules.bangladeshPositionOnDual: Bangladesh allows dual citizenship - check NOC status
citizenshipRules.childrenBornAbroad: Citizen by descent (first generation born abroad)
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Canadian citizenship is among the world's most valuable with visa-free access to 185+ countries. Dual citizenship fully permitted. No oath to renounce prior citizenship. Children born in Canada automatically citizens.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Citizenship requirements stable. French language pathway increasingly important for federal workers.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 4 years total legal residence including 1 year as PR
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: English (competency demonstrated through residency and test)
citizenshipRules.civicsTestDescription: Australian citizenship test - 20 questions from Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond
citizenshipRules.childrenBornInCountry: Citizen by birth if parent is Australian citizen or PR
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Australian citizenship accessible after only 1 year of PR with 4 years total residence. Among the faster pathways in developed world. Strong passport value.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Citizenship pathway stable. No significant reform expected.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 5 years legal residence (reduced from 8 in 2024 reform). 3 years for special achievements.
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: German B1 minimum (C1 recommended for faster pathway)
citizenshipRules.languageTest: Goethe Institut, TestDaF, or TELC German
citizenshipRules.civicsTestDescription: Einbürgerungstest - 33 questions from 310 possible. Pass mark 17/33.
citizenshipRules.criminalRecordRequirement: No criminal record. Even minor offenses can cause issues.
citizenshipRules.incomeRequirement: Must be financially self-sufficient (no Bürgergeld/social benefits)
citizenshipRules.dualCitizenshipNote: Germany's 2024 citizenship reform now allows dual citizenship for most nationalities. Historic prohibition removed.
citizenshipRules.bangladeshDualStatus: Germany now accepts dual citizenship. Bangladesh allows dual citizenship. Both possible.
citizenshipRules.childrenBornAbroad: German citizenship if parent is German
citizenshipRules.childrenBornInCountry: Jus soli if parent has 8+ years legal residence
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Historic 2024 reform reduced residency requirement to 5 years and allowed dual citizenship. This dramatically improves Germany's citizenship attractiveness. German language B1 is achievable with commitment. EU citizenship provides extraordinary value.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Citizenship pathway improved significantly. EU citizenship benefit growing. Language requirement will not be removed.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 5 years residence with 1 continuous year immediately before application
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: English or Irish (Irish Gaelic, not mandatory)
citizenshipRules.incomeRequirement: None specific but must be self-sufficient
citizenshipRules.childrenBornInCountry: Jus soli limited - child of citizen or resident 3+ years
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Irish citizenship provides EU passport - one of world's most valuable. No citizenship test makes it more accessible. Housing crisis in Dublin is main quality-of-life concern before citizenship.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Citizenship pathway stable. EU passport value increasing post-Brexit.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 5 years continuous legal residence
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: Dutch B1 (integration exam - Inburgering)
citizenshipRules.integrationExam: NT2 (Staatsexamen) - Dutch language + civic knowledge + participation exam
citizenshipRules.dualCitizenshipNote: Netherlands does NOT allow dual citizenship except in specific circumstances (born to Dutch parent, marriage to Dutch citizen, etc.). Bangladeshi nationals must renounce Bangladesh citizenship.
citizenshipRules.bangladeshPositionOnDual: Bangladesh allows dual but Netherlands does not - conflict. Bangladeshi nationals must renounce.
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Dutch citizenship requires renouncing Bangladeshi citizenship which is a major consideration. Integration exam requires Dutch language B1. EU passport value is exceptional but the dual citizenship prohibition is a significant personal and family decision.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Dual citizenship debate ongoing in Netherlands but no change expected near term.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 5 years continuous permanent residence
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: Varies - no formal national language test currently (Sweden has no mandatory citizenship language test though integration framework exists). Practical Swedish needed.
citizenshipRules.incomeRequirement: None formal but stable residence needed
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Sweden allows dual citizenship and has no mandatory language test for citizenship - unique among Scandinavian countries. However new government policies may introduce language requirements. Swedish practical proficiency is essential for employment and integration.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Language requirements for citizenship being discussed under new government. May be introduced in 2025-2027.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 5 years continuous residence (4 if married to Finnish citizen)
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: Finnish or Swedish - National Language Proficiency Certificate required
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Finnish language B1 required which is challenging given Finnish difficulty. Dual citizenship allowed. EU passport provides exceptional value. Demographics make Finland increasingly welcoming long-term.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Demographic crisis will make Finland more welcoming. Language requirement unlikely to be removed.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 9 years continuous legal residence
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: Danish - Danskprøve 3 (equivalent to B2 CEFR)
citizenshipRules.civicsTestDescription: Knowledge of Danish society, culture, and history test. 40 questions, pass mark 32.
citizenshipRules.criminalRecordRequirement: No convictions. Even small fines can cause delays.
citizenshipRules.incomeRequirement: Self-sufficient for 4 of last 5 years before application
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Denmark has Europe's most restrictive citizenship pathway at 9 years plus Danish B2, civic test, income requirements, and strict criminal record requirements. This is a significant deterrent despite excellent quality of life. EU passport value is high but pathway is longest.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Citizenship requirements unlikely to ease given political environment. May become more restrictive.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 7 years legal residence in last 10 years
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: Norwegian A2 minimum (practically B1 recommended). Language test (Norskprøve) required.
citizenshipRules.civicsTestDescription: Knowledge of Norwegian society test. Since 2021, mandatory civic knowledge course and test.
citizenshipRules.dualCitizenshipNote: Norway introduced dual citizenship in 2020. Previously prohibited.
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Norway now allows dual citizenship since 2020. 7-year pathway with language requirement. Norwegian passport is not EU but provides excellent visa-free access and EEA rights. Exceptional economic security.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Citizenship pathway stable. Dual citizenship now allowed. Language requirement will remain.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 10 years total residence minus years spent in CH between 8-18 counted double
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: Cantonal language (German, French, or Italian) minimum B1, practically B2+ required
citizenshipRules.civicsTestDescription: Cantonal and communal knowledge tests. Requirements vary significantly by canton. Community integration assessment.
citizenshipRules.communityIntegration: Interviews with local community. Social integration demonstrated. Very high bar.
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Swiss citizenship is one of the world's hardest to obtain due to community-level integration requirements, 10-year residency, cantonal variation, and high practical standards. Swiss passport is among world's strongest. The communal vote system (though legally ended 2018) still reflects community culture. For most Bangladeshi students, citizenship is a 15+ year realistic prospect.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Swiss citizenship difficulty will not decrease. Cantonal integration requirements cultural not legal.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 10 years legal residence with 5 as PR (6 years under exceptional contribution criteria)
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: German B1 plus oral exam
citizenshipRules.dualCitizenshipNote: Austria generally does NOT allow dual citizenship. Renunciation of Bangladeshi citizenship required except in very limited cases.
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Austria requires renouncing Bangladeshi citizenship (very significant decision), 10 years residency, German B1, and civic test. EU passport value is high but the pathway is long and renunciation requirement is serious. FPÖ-led government may tighten requirements further.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: May become more restrictive under current government. Renunciation requirement unlikely to be waived.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 5 years legal residence continuously
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: Dutch, French, or German (depending on region) - participation in society demonstrated
citizenshipRules.integrationConditions: Active citizenship: employment/self-employment OR civic participation OR social integration
citizenshipRules.criminalRecordRequirement: No serious convictions in last 10 years
citizenshipRules.incomeRequirement: Evidence of active citizenship (employment is primary)
citizenshipRules.childrenBornInCountry: Jus soli with parent residency conditions
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Belgium's 5-year citizenship pathway with dual citizenship allowed is very attractive. No formal language test required but integration evidence needed. Employment is the primary proof of active citizenship. EU passport value is high.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: One of Europe's more accessible citizenship pathways. Stable.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 5 years legal residence including 1240 days present physically
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: English (practical ability demonstrated through residency)
citizenshipRules.childrenBornInCountry: Jus soli if parent is citizen or permanent resident
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: New Zealand citizenship is accessible and values-based. Dual citizenship permitted. Good passport strength. The trans-Tasman agreement with Australia means NZ citizens can live and work in Australia freely. Small country but excellent quality of life.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Citizenship pathway stable. Trans-Tasman agreement with Australia provides extended value.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 5 years as permanent resident with 30 months physical presence
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: English reading, writing, and speaking ability
citizenshipRules.civicsTestDescription: 100 civics questions, 10 asked, must answer 6+ correctly. Oral interview.
citizenshipRules.criminalRecordRequirement: No aggravated felonies, no bars to good moral character
citizenshipRules.incomeRequirement: None but must have filed taxes
citizenshipRules.dualCitizenshipNote: USA allows dual citizenship de facto though formally requests loyalty oath. Bangladesh allows dual. Both countries' nationals can hold both.
citizenshipRules.childrenBornInCountry: Jus soli - automatic citizenship (birthright citizenship under 14th Amendment - current legal debate 2025)
citizenshipRules.difficulty: Very High (primarily due to PR acquisition)
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: US citizenship itself is accessible once green card (PR) obtained. The challenge is getting the green card due to per-country backlog. For Bangladeshi nationals EB-2/EB-3 wait is 50-100+ years. Birthright citizenship (jus soli) under legal/political pressure in 2025 under current administration executive orders (subject to court review). US passport has 186+ countries visa-free access.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Green card acquisition remains the critical barrier. Birthright citizenship under political pressure. Per-country cap reform stalled.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 5 years continuous legal residence
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: Japanese practical ability (approximately N3-N2 level). No formal test required but interviews in Japanese.
citizenshipRules.dualCitizenshipNote: Japan officially does NOT allow dual citizenship. Must renounce Bangladeshi citizenship upon naturalization. Enforcement has been selective but policy is clear.
citizenshipRules.bangladeshPositionOnDual: Bangladesh allows dual but Japan requires renunciation. Significant personal decision.
citizenshipRules.childrenBornInCountry: Jus sanguinis only - citizenship from parent
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Japanese citizenship requires renouncing Bangladeshi citizenship. Japanese language is practically essential. However Japan's passport is world's strongest with 193+ countries visa-free access. 5-year residency requirement is not long. The renunciation requirement is the primary deterrent.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Japan may revisit dual citizenship policy as demographic crisis deepens. No confirmed change expected by 2030.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 5 years continuous residence for general naturalization
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: Korean TOPIK Level 3+ required for naturalization test
citizenshipRules.civicsTestDescription: Social Integration Program (KIIP) completion or Naturalization exam - Korean language + Korean society, culture, history
citizenshipRules.dualCitizenshipNote: Korea allows dual citizenship ONLY for those who acquire foreign citizenship at birth (jus soli abroad) or meet very specific exemptions. General naturalization requires renouncing Bangladeshi citizenship.
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Korean citizenship requires renouncing Bangladeshi citizenship and Korean language proficiency. Korean passport is strong at 192+ countries visa-free. Demographic crisis may cause Korea to eventually allow dual citizenship. Long-term prospect improving but not immediate.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Dual citizenship policy debate ongoing due to demographic crisis. May change by 2030-2035. Monitoring recommended.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 2 years as PR before applying (PR itself takes 2-6 years to obtain)
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: English and one official language (Mandarin, Malay, or Tamil)
citizenshipRules.dualCitizenshipNote: Singapore does NOT allow dual citizenship for adults. Minors who acquire Singapore citizenship by descent may hold dual until 21 when they must choose.
citizenshipRules.bangladeshPositionOnDual: Bangladesh allows dual but Singapore requires renunciation.
citizenshipRules.childrenBornInCountry: Not automatic - must have parent who is citizen or PR
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Singapore citizenship is extremely selective. Government manages ethnic composition through citizenship grants. Even long-term PRs are often rejected for citizenship. Renunciation of Bangladeshi citizenship required. For Bangladeshi nationals without Chinese ethnic background, citizenship is practically very difficult to obtain despite meeting requirements.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Citizenship will remain extremely selective. Singapore manages demographic composition actively.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: No practical naturalization pathway. Technically available for spouses of Chinese citizens or stateless persons but essentially closed.
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: Mandarin (practical)
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: Chinese citizenship is effectively not available to foreign nationals through naturalization. China does not have a practical immigrant naturalization program. Even foreigners married to Chinese for 30+ years rarely receive citizenship.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: No change expected. China does not have citizenship by immigration framework.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: 5 years continuous legal residence (2 years if graduated from French institution after 2-year minimum)
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: French B1 minimum (DELF B2 strongly recommended)
citizenshipRules.civicsTestDescription: Civic interview covering French values, history, culture, and rights. Assimilation assessment by prefect.
citizenshipRules.childrenBornInCountry: Jus soli with residency conditions - automatic at 18 if resident since childhood
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: French citizenship accessible at 5 years or potentially 2 years for graduates of French institutions. French language B1+ required. Dual citizenship permitted. EU passport value very high. Bureaucratic process can be complex. Interview-based assimilation assessment subjective.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: Citizenship pathway may become more restrictive under political pressure. French language requirement not negotiable.

citizenshipRules.residencyCalculation: No standard naturalization pathway. Emirati citizenship granted only to exceptional cases by Ruler's decree.
citizenshipRules.languageRequirement: Arabic
citizenshipRules.keyNotes: UAE citizenship is essentially closed to the overwhelming majority of residents. Only granted by exceptional decree to investors, specialized talents, or individuals who contribute in specific ways. The UAE has no immigration to citizenship model. The Golden Visa is the practical long-term option but is not PR or citizenship.
citizenshipRules.futureOutlook: UAE citizenship will remain effectively closed. No reform anticipated.
